aarti.tek: Perform the āratī of Śrī Raghuvara, who is being, consciousness and bliss, the auspicious and the beautiful.
aarti.pad1: Of the son of Daśaratha, Kausalyā's child, protector of gods and sages, destroyer of the demons, followed by his devotees, soothing as sandal paste to the hearts of devotees: of the excellent Maryādā Puruṣottama, the Supreme Person who keeps the bounds of dharma. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Of him who is without attributes and with them, a treasury of matchless beauty, worshipped by all the worlds in many different ways, remover of grief and fear, giver of the nine treasures: of the divine best of men, untouched by māyā. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Of Jānakī's husband, sovereign of the gods, lord of the world, sustainer of all the worlds, refuge of the three worlds, adored by the universe, protector, whose ways are boundless: of the one and only refuge of all that moves and does not move. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Of him who loves those who come for refuge, true to his vow, the noble wish-granting tree of his devotees, foe of the demons, whose name, once spoken, purifies the world, friend of the monkeys, remover of the sorrows of the lowly. ॥4॥
